title: How I AI: Grok vs. Dot vs. Muse vs. Duet + How Figma’s PMs actually use AI every day
author: Lenny Rachitsky
description: Your weekly listens from How I AI, part of the Lenny's Podcast Network
summary: Claude Duet: which one crushes the competition? She tests them on everything from Slack replies, inbox triage, and coding to video editing, Figma thumbnails, family projects, and shopping.
takeaways: Choosing agents by job is more effective than expecting one product to handle everything well.
Biggest takeaways: Grok Bot is the strongest all-around personal agent in this benchmark, especially for work.
For someone choosing one agent for professional workflows, Claire recommends starting here.
